Dear Miss Yonge	
[I](/person/939) enclose a list of the presentation [copies](/book/53) we have sent out. Including those to the Press. I dont know whether there are any other papers that you have been in the habit of having your books sent to. I will send any you suggest gladly.
I am sorry that your parcel went by a route that is inconvenient to you. We will remember again when we have any thing to send.
We will advertise the [Book of Golden Deeds](/book/51) at once. When you come to London I have a larger scheme to speak to you about if you are at all free to enter into it.
I am asking [Mrs Macmillan](/person/941) to try to arrange a meeting, she will communicate with you.
My printer will not give me the exact account for the Stereotypes
[The rest of this letter is illegible.]
